environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task and code deployed in production VPC. The internal GraphQL endpoint is fronted by an Envoy sidecar proxy (deployed as a secondary container in the same task definition) configured with a custom Lua filter that enforces a strict allowlist of pre-registered query templates using normalized AST comparison. The Envoy filter computes a SHA-256 of the canonicalized GraphQL AST (stripping string literal values but preserving structure) and rejects any request whose structural hash doesn't match one of 12 pre-approved mutation shapes stored in an S3-backed config file refreshed every 60s. Additionally, the SQS dead-letter queue redrive policy is set with maxReceiveCount=1, meaning rejected messages are immediately moved to DLQ without retry. The Envoy access log emits a custom metric to CloudWatch on each rejection. Note: the SRI validation in the code itself is a defense-in-depth measure for the webhook script path and is orthogonal to the GraphQL injection vector.

config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Java 17, arm64, multi-container task definition

envoy_sidecar.canonicalization: AST normalized, string literals replaced with placeholder, field order sorted alphabetically, hash computed on resulting canonical form

config.network: Envoy binds 127.0.0.1:4000, actual GraphQL at 127.0.0.1:4001, app connects to localhost:4000
config.monitoring: CloudWatch custom metric GraphQLASTRejection with alarm threshold > 0 in 1min
